description_expanded: This spectacular Alys Beach vacation rental was the first to be offered in the The May building. Professionally decorated with many luxurious, custom-made pieces, this beautiful home will appeal to the most discerning traveler and stands out as a perfect example of the marriage of art and design. The large balcony overlooks the Alys Beach Amphitheatre and is the perfect location for enjoying sunsets and the many activities taking place throughout the year. The master bedroom offers a king-sized bed with access to the balcony and a bath with a spacious walk-in shower. The second bedroom also offers a king-sized bed, balcony access and private bath. The family room features ample seating and an open kitchen with large center island. Parking for this vacation rental is one designated space in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
